html:
Walls about 6 km long that joined Athens to its port at Piraeus. With them, Athens could be fed by sea even with an enemy army in its fields, which was the core of Pericles' plan in the Peloponnesian War.

When Athens surrendered in 404 BCE, Sparta made it pull the walls down. They were rebuilt within ten years.
